name: zeffect_anim_load_running_anim_records
description: zEffect_Anim::LoadRunningAnimRecords opens a temp read stream over a Running### record, restores entry state, runtime surface/event-stream state, skipped detached refs, and the runtime action callback.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x461040 calls zUtil_ZBD::OpenTempReadStream(data, dataSize), returns only when the temp stream is null, and otherwise reads the serialized record with fread.

The restored entry receives flags |= 0x4000, resetScratch node pointers and vectors, activation/trigger/countdown/velocity fields, runtimeSequenceCount, and runtime event-stream bytes with currentEvent relocated from the saved offset.
Light and sound ref record loops are count-driven from the saved header and only attach refs whose saved isAttached flag is non-zero; the smoke covers count consumption with detached records.
The function installs the loaded entry as runtimeNode callbackContext, sets the RunSequence action callback tail, and closes the temp stream through zUtil_ZBD::CloseTempReadStream.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect animation save/load source-cluster pass.
